verdict_rationale: POS V4 SHELL renders correctly (UI/Q10/cash modal/categories all visible and intact). However, two P0 blockers prevent completing the real vente directe flow: (P0-1) item-click navigation hijack, (P0-2) /admin/pos-orders + /admin/pos redirect to KDS via SPA router. NF525 chain integrity verified intact (6 audit entries, hash chained). HEAL-4 refund modal + Q10 panel CODE present, UX path blocked by navigation issue.

critical_findings.title: POS item-click navigates to KDS instead of adding to cart
critical_findings.evidence: Captures 10 + 11 ; clicking aria-label='Ajouter Frites Seules, 2,00 €' button (simple item, status=5/active, price=2€) triggers browser navigation to /admin/kitchen-display-system. Console shows 0 errors during click. Same behaviour observed when navigating to /admin/pos-orders.
critical_findings.impact: Cashier cannot create any vente directe order. Blocks the entire POS revenue flow. NF525 fiscal_sequence_no unallocated because no order ever reaches PosController::store.
critical_findings.reproduction: 1. Login admin@lecayenne.fr. 2. /admin/pos-v4. 3. Open cash drawer 50€. 4. Click any product tile. → Browser navigates to KDS.
critical_findings.suspected_root_cause: router beforeEach guard reading authDefaultPermission for staffOnlyMode admin may redirect to KDS (admin's default permission landing). May also be a Vue-router replace() side-effect during cart state update conflicting with auth guard.

critical_findings.title: /admin/pos and /admin/pos-orders SPA routes redirect to /admin/kitchen-display-system
critical_findings.evidence: Captures 03 + 04 + 11 ; direct navigation to /admin/pos or /admin/pos-orders consistently lands on KDS after 1-3s SPA bootstrap. /admin/pos-v4 (dedicated controller, no SPA router) reaches the POS shell correctly.
critical_findings.impact: Sidebar nav 'POS' link (e37, href=/admin/pos) and 'Commandes caisse' link (e60, href=/admin/pos-orders) are broken for admin user. Workaround: /admin/pos-v4 direct URL.
critical_findings.suspected_root_cause: resources/js/router/index.js posRoutes uses meta.permissionUrl='pos'. handlePermissionDenied() called even though user.can('pos')=true (verified via tinker getAllPermissions). Likely store.getters.authPermission entry has access=false despite Spatie having the grant — store hydration mismatch.
